ingest.note: Uses Deepgram's utterance endpointing to detect turn boundaries. Configured via Deepgram STT live_options.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: Deepgram's endpointing detects when a user finishes speaking (or starts speaking during agent output) using the interim_results + endpointing parameter. Configure endpointing_ms (default 300ms, lower for faster interruption).
interruption.code_hint: Pipecat: DeepgramSTTService(live_options={'interim_results': True, 'endpointing': 300}). LiveKit: deepgram.STT with turn detection config.

potholes.note: The endpointing parameter (ms) adds delay before a turn is considered complete. 300ms is default; lower to 100-200ms for faster interruption but more false triggers.
Deepgram endpointing only works when Deepgram is the STT provider. Select Silero VAD if using a different STT.

cost_estimates.notes: Bundled with Deepgram STT billing (Nova-3 rate)
